verdict.rationale: BILL's own Spend & Expense marketing describes AI-powered spend management in which every transaction is "categorized, and automatically compliant", which covers the AI-coding core of the story at a marketing level only. The Invoice Coding Agent is an adjacent AP bill-coding feature, so it is not credited toward expense coding. Missing for 10: AI receipt reading/OCR, AI-suggested memos, duplicate detection, fraud detection, detailed docs on how AI categorization works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
